Verified current scope: workstation/cell; evidence level is stated in the claim ledger. Public evidence supports responsibility for models/policies, simulation/training, integration and remote operations; supports only partial/shared responsibility for hardware and ongoing support/maintenance; does not establish responsibility for robot body, end effectors/tooling, commissioning/qualification and hardware financing/RaaS. Overall integration responsibility is classified as shared. Commercial evidence: 3_partner_confirmed_or_customer_pilot; technical evidence: 4_named_partner_confirmed. These are public-evidence classifications, not proof of contract scope, uptime, economics or performance.
